notablePrerequisites:
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Basilisk Collar attached to Deathbringer Thoctar.
description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls and causing you to gain 1 life.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Deathbringer Thoctar's deathtouch.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
